intro: Alina is designed to redefine your space. Crafted for practicality and elegance featuring a walnut wood grain finish, this wardrobe blends modern and functional design to meet your storage needs.

features.title: A timeless design with a natural glow
features.text: The rich walnut wood grain finish brings natural warmth and timeless style to your living space, making the wardrobe a refined addition to your décor.

features.title: A drawer that keeps your valuables locked
features.text: Keep your valuable items safe with a dedicated lockable drawer, perfect for organizing important documents, jewellery, or other essentials.

features.title: A closet that holds your fashion spree
features.text: With uninterrupted hanging storage, the Alina wardrobe accommodates all your clothes, from casual outfits to long dresses, with ease.

features.title: Custom storage for every day
features.text: Customizable shelves let you adapt the storage space to suit your needs, ensuring everything finds its perfect place.

features.title: Built to last for years
features.text: With back panels and drawer bottoms engineered for extra strength, this wardrobe is built to last, offering long-term reliability and structural stability.

care: Wipe your wooden almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
